facts.text: Deborah received a bouquet of flowers from a friend during a time of struggle, which provides her with hope and courage.

evidence.quote: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage.

facts.text: Deborah believes that something as simple as flowers can make a real difference in people's lives.

evidence.quote: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference.

facts.text: Deborah associates the bouquet with feelings of warmth and appreciation when she looks at it.

evidence.quote: I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
